_readme: Copy to data/matterport/api.json and fill every null from the hackathon quickstart:
Do not guess values. endpoint: GraphQL URL. auth: 'basic' (two env vars: id, secret),
'bearer' (one env var) or 'header:<Name>' (one env var). env_vars: credential variable
names exactly as the quickstart writes them; their values go in .env.local (git-ignored).
pano_query: query text taking $modelId and returning panoLocations. pano_list_path: keys
from the response root to that list. fields: keys inside one pano entry (id, label,
position per PLAN.md). face_urls_path: keys from a pano entry (or from the skybox_query
response, which takes $modelId and $panoId) to the six 2k face URLs, or to a URL
